name: paxflux
description: Self-hosted realtime crowd flow & occupancy management.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @paxflux/shared && npm run build -w @paxflux/server && npm run build -w @paxflux/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @paxflux/shared && npm run typecheck -w @paxflux/server && npm run typecheck -w @paxflux/web
scripts.pretest:e2e: rimraf tests/e2e/.data tests/e2e/.backups && npm run build
